issues.problem: Key coverage RESOLVED, verified mechanically: fil.json now has 140 of the 140 keys in en.json (was 91), 0 missing, 0 extra, all {cur}/{need}/{sec}/{cat}/{n}/{kinds}/{name} placeholders match en exactly (0 param violations, 0 unbalanced braces, 0 whitespace anomalies). 48 of the 49 new keys are genuine Filipino. The other values identical to en - autoOn/hud.btn.auto/hud.btn.auto.short (AUTO), hud.btn.menu and menu (Menu/MENU), fps (FPS), wiki (WIKI) - are accepted Filipino loan forms, not copies.

issues.problem: STILL AN ENGLISH COPY - the only one in the three files reviewed. fil legend = 'Legend' is the verbatim en value. It is not a loan-word case: Filipino uses the Spanish loan 'Leyenda' for a map/chart legend (es ships 'Leyenda', ru 'Легенда', tr uses the equivalent key). It renders twice: on the pause button pLegend (js/ui_menus.js:153) and as the legend panel head/toggle text (js/ui.js:220 'Legend ▾' and js/ui.js:256), so a Filipino player sees an English word on a control and on a panel title. Under the round-2 rule (an English value in a non-English language is a meaning/glossary error) this is the reason fil stays under 8.

NEW (one of the 49): 'Shell ng silica (20 DNA)' keeps the English head noun 'Shell' in the X slot of the correct Filipino frame X ng Y, and keeps the English/Latin spelling 'silica'. Compare es 'Caparazón de sílice', tr 'Silis kabuk', ru Кремниевый панцирь. The DNA panel is rendered by js/ui_menus.js:176, so this is a visible label, not a comment.

NEW: 'pindutin ang ibang button para lumipat' - 'button' is the English word inside a Filipino sentence, while the same file already uses the native verb pindutin. It is printed inside the composed filter status bar #spFilterStatus at 11px opacity .6 (js/ui_menus.js:59), next to Pansala (filter), so the English noun is conspicuous.
issues.fix: pindutin ang ibang pindutan para lumipat

issues.problem: NEW glossary split across four keys, all English spelling: camFly 'Lipad ng camera', mapTip 'Ang click ay nagpapalipat ng camera', virusMode 'WASD ang gumagalaw ng camera', and freeCam 'Malayang cam' (three full English words plus one bare English abbreviation). issues.fix: camFly: 'Lipad ng kamera' | mapTip: '...nagpapalipat ng kamera.' | virusMode: '...WASD ang gumagalaw ng kamera.' | freeCam: 'Malayang kamera'

issues.problem: NEW: the English/Latin plural 'bacteria' is kept in midEaterTip ('...sa mga berde o bacteria') and virusMode ('Mag-click sa isang bacteria para mahawaan'); Filipino spelling is 'bakterya' (es bacterias, tr bakteri). dnaSpeed has the same pattern with the Latin plural 'flagella' instead of 'flagelo'. issues.fix: midEaterTip: '...sa mga berde o bakterya...' | virusMode: '...sa isang bakterya...' | dnaSpeed: 'Mas mabilis na flagelo (5 DNA)'

Round-1 fix NOT applied: bare 'Kumain' is aspect-ambiguous - the -um- perfective reads as 'ate' only with the actor present, while 'Kumain ka!' is the command 'eat!'. It is the eat feedback toast (js/main_events.js:185) fired right after the KAIN button (hud.btn.eat/.short), so button and confirmation look identical. ru Съел, es Comiste, tr Yedin are all explicitly 2nd-person completed.
